data.body:
AC amendment: Add acceptance criterion to verify DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET suppresses the deprecation warning when falling back to old key.

Additional AC item to add to Task 2:
- [ ] DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET=1 suppresses deprecation warning during old-key fallback
  Verify: echo 'review.max_resolution_attempts=7' > /tmp/test-quiet.conf && stderr=$(DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET=1 bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh review.max_cycles /tmp/test-quiet.conf 2>&1 1>/dev/null) && [ -z "$stderr" ]

Also ensure the shim includes: [[ -z "${DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET:-}" ]] guard before emitting deprecation, mirroring the dso.workflow shim pattern.
